title: Studio dashboard Global Filters: a partly filled "Options From" (object set, value and label fields not yet) autosaves, is refused 422, and every later dashboard edit is refused and lost on reload
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types acceptance[4]).
Business reason: a dashboard author who adds a select global filter and fills its "Options From" object first sees "Changes not saved: the server refused this draft", and every edit made after that (label, description, other widgets) is refused too and silently lost on reload. #27459 fixed the empty-item case; this is the partly filled case of the same promise ("the editor never autosaves an incomplete filter").
Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch), then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`. QA suggestion only: `area:studio`, p2.
Duplicate search: `listItemHeldInput` → 2 hits (#27459 closed, #27785 closed: the empty-item and report-list siblings, neither covers a nested object input). `optionsFrom global filter Studio` → 14 hits, all QA run records or the sweep anchor.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase. Use a writable package with an app whose navigation names a dashboard with one metric widget (QA used package `com.qa.r3`, dashboard `r3_hold` on dataset `r3_ticket_metrics`).
2. Open `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces`, select the dashboard → Properties → Filters → Global Filters → "Add item". No PUT is sent (held, as designed after #27459).
3. Fill Field (`region`), then set Input Type = select. Each step sends `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/r3_hold?mode=draft&package=PKG&surface=studio` → 200.
4. Type `r3_ticket` into Options From → Object (`#mdf-globalFilters.N.optionsFrom.object`) and press Tab. The PUT body carries `"optionsFrom":{"object":"r3_ticket"}` → **422 INVALID_METADATA**, issues `globalFilters.N.optionsFrom.valueField [invalid_type]` and `…labelField [invalid_type]`.
5. Edit the dashboard Description, then its Label. Each PUT carries the same incomplete item and is refused 422.
6. Reload. No leave prompt (`new Event('beforeunload',{cancelable:true})` leaves `defaultPrevented` false). The Description and Label edits are gone, and the draft read shows neither.

Expected: the partly filled item is held like the empty one (or the refused edits are guarded on leave), and no other edit is lost. Actual: as above. Reproduced 3 times on fresh loads.

## Mechanism (suspected; the implementer verifies)
`listItemHeldInput()` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts` holds an item only when every issue names an unset input directly below the item (`input = path[at + 1]`). For `globalFilters.N.optionsFrom.valueField` that input is `optionsFrom`, which already holds `{object}`, so the item is classed "finished but wrong" and sent. The surface guard in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`leafIncomplete` → `useDraftAutoSave` blocked) never engages, and nothing arms beforeunload for a refused draft.

Contract: `GlobalFilterSchema.optionsFrom` (`packages/spec`), unchanged; the fix is client-side.
